lines.text: So it went mid-run on Saturday?
Yeah, I'm coming in with a pulled right calf, it felt like someone kicked me.
Let me have a look. Rise up onto your toes on the right leg for me.
Can't do it, it's too sore.
There's a tender spot in the middle of the muscle about a hand's width below the knee, it's a grade one strain.
Walk normally as much as you can, and no jogging for two weeks, then start with one minute running and one minute walking.
No worries, look after yourself. Hello there, you must be Mrs Haddad, how was the drive in?
Not bad, the bypass was clear for once.
Oh good. Come and sit down, what's been going on?
It's my neck, I woke up last Tuesday and couldn't turn it to the left at all.
